summary.text: Jim Creighton is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Hillsborough 30, and is the Republican candidate for New Hampshire State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is not running for re-election to the House.
David Trumble, a Democrat, is also on the District 8 general-election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Creighton was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and served in the U.S. Army from 1978 to 2012.

Creighton graduated from Granada Hills High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 1982, and earned master's degrees from Marine Staff College and National War College in 1994 and 2002, respectively.

Creighton's career experience includes operating Eagle Point Global Solutions, LLC, Ursa Major Northeast Guides, LLC, and EastWest Institute, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as small business owner.
Creighton has served in the New Hampshire House representing Hillsborough 30 and, in the 2023-2024 session, was vice chair of the Environment and Agriculture Committee.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Creighton described himself as a two-term state representative, Army veteran, business owner and educator, and said his goals included empowering businesses and reducing red tape, giving parents choice in how their children are educated, supporting veterans' issues, preserving the Second Amendment and protecting the environment.
